messages:
ana: Quick draft: updating SOC2 audit-log doc to (a) clarify default retention, (b) show tenant-scoped example, (c) include small SDK migration note. Can I get a couple quick checks?

mike: Sure. What's the proposed wording for retention?

ana: Proposed: "By default, Redwood retains audit logs for 90 days. Enterprise customers may request extended retention through contract. For Dedicated/Private deployments retention is configurable by operators."

legal_claire: Looks good. Suggest adding: "Redwood segregates tenant logs and does not expose tenant data across customers. Logs are encrypted at rest; Private deployments can be configured to use customer-managed KMS."

ana: Adding that. Draft tenant-scoped example JSON (for docs):
```json
{
  "name": "model.invoke",
  "tenant_id": "tenant_007",
  "data": { "prompt": "[REDACTED]" },
  "redacted_fields": ["prompt"],
  "timestamp": "2026-04-02T09:00:00Z"
}
```

mike: For the SDK migration note: old `client.audit.log({ event, tenantId, payload })` -> new `client.audit.emit({ name, tenantId, data })`. Also note wire-level JSON uses snake_case for tenant_id. Example snippet?

ana: Adding:```js
// Old
await client.audit.log({ event: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'tenant_007', payload });
// New
await client.audit.emit({ name: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'tenant_007', data: payload });
```

docs-lint-bot: lint: please avoid words like "never" in SOC2 docs. Also: add an operator-only curl appendix if you want to show HTTP shape.

legal_claire: Also add a line advising customers to redact PII from prompt text or use the `redacted_fields` array.

ana: Will do. I'll open the PR and tag legal for quick review. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2510 (WIP).

mike: Great. Ping when it's ready for review.

ana: Thanks everyone! :pray:
